gbm_population_evidence.quote: Diagnosis of glioblastoma confirmed by histology

candidate_evidence.quote: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the efficacy and safety of Iodine-125 brachytherapy together with chemotherapy compared with surgical resection followed by concomitant radiochemotherapy in patients with newly diagnosed glioblastoma.
Temozolomide: 75 mg per square meter of body-surface area per day, 7 days per week,42 days.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Iodine-125 Brachytherapy Together With Chemotherapy in Patients With Newly Diagnosed Glioblastoma
No prior anticancer therapy for glioblastoma besides biopsy.

coder_notes: Registered phase NA. Investigational question is Iodine-125 seed brachytherapy (radiotherapy, given in mCi with prescribed dose in Gy) versus surgery + external radiotherapy; I-125 brachytherapy treated as radiotherapy, not listed as an agent. Temozolomide given at the same dose/schedule (75 mg/m2/day x 42 days) in both arms -> soc_backbone. No pharmacological candidate.
